# engineering

Open the one topic the step at hand needs:

- When adding a function, module, helper or test fixture: read [one-job-one-home](one-job-one-home.md).
- When about to hand-roll a glob, walk, parse or diff: read [libraries-first](libraries-first.md).
- When widening a shared enumeration or adding a parallel struct: read [shared-concept](shared-concept.md).
- When storing a value another value already determines: read [derived-state](derived-state.md).
- When fixing a defect one kind or one path exposed: read [fix-at-the-mechanism](fix-at-the-mechanism.md).
- When shipping a surface that composes with existing ones: read [gauntlet](gauntlet.md).
- When adding a walk, a file read, a parse or a glob compile: read [cost-scale](cost-scale.md).
- When writing a test that asserts a verdict: read [non-vacuous](non-vacuous.md).
- When adding a reader that consumes a key: read [reader-reports](reader-reports.md).
- When fixing a bug: read [fix-ships-its-test](fix-ships-its-test.md).
- When testing agreement across the SDK and engine seam: read [seam-gate](seam-gate.md).
- When adding a pub item or an SDK export: read [export-earns-consumer](export-earns-consumer.md).
- When writing a comment, a doc header or other prose: read [narration](narration.md).
- When adding a module or a directory under src/: read [flat-tree](flat-tree.md).
- When naming a Claude Code fact outside the provider face: read [provider-face](provider-face.md).
